title: Pin ShipStation consumer leadership and make fulfillment-outbox health age-based

acceptanceCriteria.description: ShipStation consumer leadership remains on one reserved session while its URL owner converts the legacy Supabase transaction-pooler fallback to session mode, accepts an explicit direct/session URL, and rejects an explicitly configured transaction-mode leadership URL.
Fulfillment-outbox skip health delegates its threshold to the canonical one-minute cadence and remains healthy for three rapid lane-blocked skips instead of failing on raw count.

A persistent skip, stale prior success, or never-fetched outbox job fails backend deep health after the three-cadence age budget, while the route only renders the canonical verdict and sanitized timing facts.
Provider execution and durable fulfillment behavior remain unchanged and provider-safe under lost response, restart, concurrency, fencing, and starvation failure scenarios.
Strict TypeScript, production web build, the full source-of-truth pack, and shipped/cancelled lockdown guards pass at the exact reviewed implementation SHA with no protected file change.

canonicalOwners: src/services/sync-job-queue.ts ShipStationConsumerLeadershipController for leader acquisition, handoff, connection health, and release
src/lib/sync-cadence.ts for the fulfillment-outbox cadence used to derive the liveness budget

oldOwners.delegatesTo: elapsed skip age derived from src/lib/sync-cadence.ts

oldOwners.path: src/routes/health.ts implicit assumption that a non-skipped prior result is healthy forever
oldOwners.delegatesTo: src/services/worker-job-skip-health.ts latest-run and worker-start grace verdict

wrappers.delegatesTo: evaluateWorkerJobSkipHealth and only renders its reason/timing fields
isSupabaseTransactionPoolerUrl for connection-mode classification before the reserved leader client is created

sotBypass.details: The readiness rule stays in the backend health owner, cadence remains canonical, and the route is a thin renderer. No frontend, connector, or provider adapter chooses leadership, liveness, fulfillment, or marketplace-confirmation truth.
